individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is composed only of micrograph images (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge); there is no plot of averaged data.
The two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity, anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) show only group means with error bars; no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a western blot image only, with no accompanying quantification plot.
The SDH and COX signal-intensity bar charts show only means with error bars and sample-size numbers (N) inside the bars; individual data points are not displayed.

The FACS panels are histogram/distribution plots (cell counts vs TMRM intensity) that already display the full underlying data distribution, so overlaying individual points is not applicable; the top-right idealized curve is a schematic illustration, not a data plot.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - Panel A contains only micrographs, no error bars.
FAIL - The JC-1 and anti-HMGB1 bar charts show error bars (with n=20 and significance annotations), but the caption text does not state what the error bars represent (e.g., SD or SEM).
not needed - Panel C is a western blot with no plotted error bars.
FAIL - The SDH and COX signal-intensity bar charts display error bars, but the caption does not specify whether they represent SD, SEM, or another measure of variability.
not needed - The FACS histograms and schematic panels do not contain error bars.
